raw_text:
Example Lab released a smaller inference model this morning and published a release post beside it.

The laboratory says the model cut its cost per million tokens by 34 percent against the release it replaces, and that the same weights raised throughput on commodity processors by 18 percent. Neither figure is attributed to an outside benchmark. The post does not name the hardware either measurement ran on, nor the prompt lengths behind the throughput claim.

A researcher at a rival group said the numbers were plausible but unverifiable without the evaluation harness. Example Lab said it plans to publish that harness later in the year. The company has not said when.
